lines: Well done, my friend, you passed every test successfully
and the Ultimate campaign is now over.
However, don't believe that your adventure ends here!
You can still download new maps or play other campaigns.
You can also try to beat your time and take
the first place on the leaderboards!
Don't forget to visit the blog for the latest news:
http://stillalivejs.t4ils.com/
See you next time!
Thank you for playing Still Alive
I hope you had as much fun playing the game as I had making it
Game created by t4ils
Gfx by ZeBlackos (thanks!!!)
Original idea by Valve Software
Thanks to my life partner, who let me create my game during
these past 2 months, when I spent most of my time
on the computer (sorry about that!)
Big thanks to Braynor and LordYu for their thorough beta
testing during the whole development phase.
Thanks to EvilTroopa and dev-fr.org for their support
during development and for testing the game.
Thanks to the Trackmania and StillAliveDS forum members
for testing the game when it was almost complete.
